system.description:
Unless Vulnerable, this vehicle is immune to damage from attacks by creatures or vehicles without the Massive feature.

  • If attacked by another Massive vehicle or creature, it suffers damage normally.

  • When this vehicle makes an attack against a target without this feature, that target must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (though they may still use armor to reduce damage).

  • If they cannot mark an Armor Slot, they must instead mark an additional HP.
